title: 2023 AMC 12B Problem 3
statement: A \(3\)-\(4\)-\(5\) right triangle is inscribed in circle \(A,\) and a \(5\)-\(12\)-\(13\) right triangle is inscribed in circle \(B.\) What is the ratio of the area of circle \(A\) to the area of circle \(B?\)

solutions.text:
The hypotenuse of an inscribed right triangle is a diameter, so circle \(A\) has diameter \(5\) and circle \(B\) has diameter \(13.\) The ratio of areas is \(\left(\tfrac{5}{13}\right)^2= \tfrac{25}{169}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: A right triangle inscribed in a circle has its hypotenuse as a diameter
The circles have diameters \(5\) and \(13;\) the area ratio is the square of the ratio of radii
